ceu: ✦ The trine between Mercury and Mars

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between Mercury and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.
